rationale: Tests understanding of the three cytogenetic mechanisms of Down syndrome and their distinct recurrence risks — the core of PE29.1.
Consolidates knowledge of the most common cardiac defect and pathognomonic GI anomaly in Down syndrome — high-yield clinical associations.
Addresses the classic PE known-trap: the correct karyotype notation is 45,X — NOT 45,XO — and tests the SHOX gene link to short stature.
Tests application of management principles — timing of GH and oestrogen replacement — at the clinical level required by PE29.4.
Tests the pathophysiological mechanism of hypergonadotropic hypogonadism in Klinefelter syndrome and the correct karyotype — core PE29.5 content.
Tests management initiation — testosterone replacement in Klinefelter syndrome — and the surveillance requirement for gynaecomastia-related breast cancer risk.
